## Execution audit

**Provenance and citation key.** All citations refer to original expanded files under `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/replay_s1/H_start/H_start/`. Their corresponding archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/replay_s1--H_start.tar.gz`; each member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/replay_s1/H_start/H_start/` followed by the cited relative file path. Line numbers below are those of the original expanded files.

### Archive corridor: development `commons_2238909`

Step 3 code states an intent to add two foreground winding handles, lower plaques and darken surfaces. It constructs 25 shelving banks from boxes and rods, an exposed bay of 25 box-books, carts, fixtures and an exit marker; plaque print is represented by small boxes rather than text. These are designed arrangements, not evidence of physical contact. [X1263, `replay_development/commons_2238909/steps/003/build.py`, lines 5–7, 38–98, 100–162]

The code sets Principled roughness, a shinier floor and emissive tubes, without an explicit image-texture operation. Camera position is `(-1.13,-3.45,1.56)`, yaw 27°, lens 30/sensor 36; ten 90-power area emitters plus fill and a dim world illuminate a 512×384 Cycles scene. It requests 32 samples and denoising, but the execution log reports **16/16 samples**, not 32. [X1263, same file, lines 164–210; X1264, `replay_development/commons_2238909/steps/003/result.json`, line 5]

Steps 2 and 3 both report `ok: true`, empty stderr, completed 16-sample renders, saved PNGs and `scene.blend`; step 3 took 13.68 seconds including saving. No step-3 geometry measurements or visual assessment are supplied. [X1262, `replay_development/commons_2238909/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1264, same result file, lines 2–7]

### Historic kitchen: selection `commons_29206714`

The selected step-3 code represents a dresser with separately constructed doors rotated ±135° about specified pivots, then scales the cabinet, china and yarn apparatus to 87% in X. Six plates use layered rods and small geometric leaf/sprig decorations; pots combine balls, rods and swept handles. A foreground wheel uses 40 rod rim segments, ten spokes, hub and legs. Compared with step 1, the stated revisions narrow the cabinet, darken wood and alter the wheel and door panels; the code uses an overlap operation for the arches. These construction coordinates do not establish hinge, vessel-handle, shelf-support or wheel contact. [X1274, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/003/build.py`, lines 4–6, 33–80, 83–150, 152–169; X1270, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/001/build.py`, lines 69–85, 156–175]

For qualifying reddish materials, generated coordinates feed scaled noise, a color ramp and bump; glass rods have specified opacity. Step 3 sets a 67 mm lens, two area lights, world strength 0.20, AgX and 512×339 output. [X1274, same build file, lines 128–131, 171–217; X1276, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/task.json`, lines 2–5]

All three kitchen step logs report successful 16-sample renders and saved PNG and blend files, with empty stderr; step 3 reports 5.97 seconds. `selected.json` records step 3, although the record’s separate `selected` field is null. The record reports CPU, three executions, valid metrics and functional passes for target `China`; its own interpretation limits those passes to structural/edit operability, while semantic completeness and support/collision truth are null. Reported SSIM is 0.338 and overall 0.555—not independent proof of quality or acceptance. [X1271, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1273, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/002/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1275, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; X1268, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/selected.json`, line 2; X1267, `replay_selection/commons_29206714/record.json`, lines 16–38, 47–57]

### Bedroom: test `commons_52210054`

The supplied final build constructs a canopy bed with posts, valances, scalloped balls and rod folds; separate seating, lamps, carpet and tea stand use primitive and swept parts. The target `Far lamp` is a composite of base, stem, cylindrical shade and ribs. Procedural noise colors walls and textiles, Voronoi and a multistop ramp color the rug, textile noise drives bump, and shade materials receive emission. Camera is `(3.45,-7,2.85)`, lens 49/sensor 36, with three area lights and 512×340 AgX output. [X1277, `replay_test/commons_52210054/build.py`, lines 64–103, 127–162, 164–186, 197–286]

The record reports complete, CPU, three executions, no runtime error, step 3 selected, and structural/material/composite passes for `Far lamp`; semantic completeness and collision truth remain null. SSIM 0.137 and overall 0.430 are recorded metrics, not validated visual acceptance. Unlike the kitchen, individual bedroom render logs are not supplied here. [X1278, `replay_test/commons_52210054/record.json`, lines 16–53; X1279, `replay_test/commons_52210054/selected.json`, line 2]

**Quality limit:** No reference or render images were attached, and no measured AABBs or contact tests are supplied. Successful logged rendering is technically distinct from reconstruction fidelity; the visual quality of these completed scenes cannot be independently determined from this text alone.
